Accio is an AI agentic business platform that automates design, trend analysis, global product sourcing, and supplier contact — all in one ask.

Connected to Alibaba.com, 1688, Taobao, and AliExpress, Accio helps you find verified suppliers, validate products, and move from idea to execution in minutes.

🤖 One AI Agent. End-to-End Workflow.

With the Accio AI Agent, you can:

Generate product ideas and initial designs

Analyze market trends and product demand

Discover winning products across global wholesale marketplaces

Match with verified suppliers

Initiate supplier contact instantly

No switching tools. No manual research. Just one ask.

🌍 Global Sourcing Made Smarter

Accio connects you to:

1.5M+ verified suppliers

7,600+ wholesale product categories

400M+ products

Direct sourcing from Alibaba, 1688, Taobao, and AliExpress

From apparel and consumer goods to industrial machinery, Accio supports retailers, wholesalers, and e-commerce sellers worldwide.

📊 AI-Powered Trend & Market Intelligence

Before you invest, Accio helps you:

Analyze demand with real-time market insights

Identify trending and high-potential products

Validate supplier and product data through AI cross-verification

Turn weeks of product research into seconds

⚡ From Idea to Supplier — In One Ask

Unlike traditional sourcing tools, Accio’s AI Agent handles the entire workflow:

Design → Trend Analysis → Product Discovery → Supplier Matching → Supplier Contact

All powered by advanced AI technologies and built on 25+ years of B2B ecosystem expertise.

Over 3 million business users worldwide trust Accio to streamline their sourcing process.
